functions.name: MoE.forward
functions.reviewed_only: routing/reduction order reviewed; reduction/shared experts not executed

operation_contract.expert_order: w1 gate projection and w3 up projection; clamp up to [-limit,limit], clamp gate max=limit; silu(gate)*up; STOP weight application; w2 down projection returns single expert output
operation_contract.fp4_linear_contract: quantized Linear first FP8-quantizes/dequantizes the BF16 activation with block size 32, then applies I8-packed FP4 E2M1 weights (low nibble then high nibble) scaled per 32 input values by E8M0 scale; projection output is BF16
operation_contract.gate_order: raw=linear(x.float, weight.float)/gate_temp; scores=sqrt(softplus(raw)); indices=topk(scores+bias); weights=gather(unbiased scores); normalize selected scores; multiply route_scale
operation_contract.topk_ties: fixture avoids ties; numpy stable descending argsort used only where scores are non-tied
